mie-context.description: Show compact branch and diff context
mie-context.template: Run `node scripts/harness/context.mjs` and report only anomalies or blockers. $ARGUMENTS

mie-task.template: Read `docs/agent/NEXT.md` and `docs/agent/WORKFLOW.md`. Run `node scripts/harness/context.mjs`. If the checkpoint status is not READY, stop. Otherwise implement only its allowed scope, run relevant checks, inspect the actual diff, and stop before staging, committing, pushing, or deploying. $ARGUMENTS

mie-gate.description: Run the static gate and inspect the active checkpoint diff
mie-gate.template: Read `docs/agent/NEXT.md`. Do not modify files. Run `node scripts/harness/verify-static.mjs`, inspect the actual diff against the allowed files and acceptance checks, and report PASS or FAIL with only actionable findings. Do not stage or commit. $ARGUMENTS
